provenance.failed_path_attempt: First attempt failed while serializing relative paths; its artifacts remain separate. Budgets and data were unchanged.

profile_remeasurement.reason: Initial profile overlapped another experiment's tail; repeat the same frozen workload after other experiment processes completed. Training, data and reproduction outcomes are unchanged.

scope: Four bounded CPU practice studies; correctness status does not mean fluent text, length extrapolation or GPU speed

frozen.checkpoint_selection: final fixed budget; no held-out tuning or early stopping
frozen.support_intervention: append disjoint training groups at lengths 6..8; identical optimizer-update budget, NOT identical token/FLOP budget
frozen.eos_probe: suppress EOS before record target length; task-aware diagnostic policy, not the original model's unconstrained generation
frozen.position_probe: shift fixed sinusoidal position signals by +4 at inference; input perturbation, not retraining a different positional architecture

limits: EOS suppression uses task length and changes inference policy; it is diagnostic, not an unconstrained capability score
position shift tests sensitivity only; it cannot establish which positional architecture would generalize after training
support comparison holds optimizer updates fixed; token consumption and padded compute change; do not attribute all differences solely to length coverage
test 9..10 remains outside both training supports; all seeds and outcomes are retained

corpus.scope: Chinese natural-language engineering paragraphs authored in this repository; no external corpus, synthetic story generator, pretrained model or downloaded tokenizer. Narrow-domain document holdout, not a general Chinese language benchmark.
corpus.near_duplicate_audit: not established; narrow-domain shared vocabulary and semantic overlap remain

resume.scope: CPU single process, dropout=0; sampler has its own Python Random state; no asynchronous data workers or GPU RNG

limits: real natural-language paragraphs from this Wiki; NOT TinyStories, a broad web corpus or instruction tuning
document IDs and exact paragraph hashes are disjoint; semantic and near-duplicate independence is not established
no trained tokenizer outside the training split; loss units only compare with this saved tokenizer
teacher-forced CE/accuracy and 48-token greedy samples do not demonstrate factual reliability, instruction following or general Chinese fluency
invalid UTF-8 replacements and emitted non-EOS special tokens are retained and reported

historical_difference.reason: old page snapshot and new run differ, but old complete checkpoints/traces are unavailable; these controlled probes do not establish that historical cause

reproduction.scope: same CPU and installed PyTorch, 16 updates; float64 cast and changed data order are intentional new interventions, not different OS/GPU reproductions
levels: cross-environment numerical agreement under declared tolerance

frozen.timing_order: alternate method order each iteration; distinct models/optimizers with identical initial values and batch sequence
frozen.timing_scope: pretokenized records collate + zero grad + hidden forward + output/loss + backward + clipping + AdamW; no disk input, tokenization, profiler or saved-tensor hooks in timed runs

saved_storage.includes: Unique backing storages referenced by tensors saved for backward, including H/W/bias and labels. Views share a storage and count once.
saved_storage.excludes: Unsaved tiles and GEMM temporaries, gradient buffers, allocator allocated/reserved peaks, process RSS and GPU memory.

saved_storage.includes: Unique backing storages referenced by tensors saved for backward, including H/W/bias and labels. Views share a storage and count once.
saved_storage.excludes: Unsaved tiles and GEMM temporaries, gradient buffers, allocator allocated/reserved peaks, process RSS and GPU memory.

limits: CPU double precision timing, not GPU or the float32 training throughput
saved storage references are not allocator/RSS/physical memory peaks
stage medians need not sum to the total median; raw paired per-step samples do sum
evaluation and writes measured separately; write timing does not guarantee fsync durability
no full model retraining quality claim from changing the CE implementation
